# NES Flooring

> Family-owned epoxy flooring contractor based in Weatherford, Texas, serving Parker County, Fort Worth, Granbury, and surrounding North Texas communities. Installs flake and solid color epoxy floor systems with diamond-ground prep, a moisture-barrier epoxy base, and a UV-resistant polyaspartic topcoat. 10-year workmanship warranty. No subcontractors. Phone 817-668-5051.

Key facts:
- Cure times: walk after 12 hours, drive after 72 hours.
- Materials: industrial-grade products from Versatile.net.
- Does not install metallic epoxy.
- Free on-site consultation and detailed written quote with no hidden fees.
